rain: Ana ruwa a Marlow Street, irin ruwan da ke danne ƙarar takun sawu.
call: Jim kaɗan bayan tsakar dare, wani ya kira game da wani mutum da ke kwance a lungu da ke bayan gidan burodi.
tape: Jami'ar binciken laifuka Nia ta tsaya a bayan tef ɗin rawaya da aka yi shinge da shi, tana kallon lungu yana numfasawa da hasken ja da shuɗi.
tape.ask: Wace ce jami'ar binciken laifuka Nia?
bello: A gefenta jami’i Bello ya tsaya, matashi kuma jikinsa ya jike sharkaf, yana ƙoƙarin kada ya nuna damuwa.
nobody: “Babu wanda ya ji komai,” in ji shi. “Ba ihu ba, ba mota ba. Babu komai.”
lift: Nia ta ɗaga tef ɗin sannan ta shiga cikin lungu.
puddles: Kududdufan ruwan suna kyalli a duk lokacin da fitilun ’yan sanda suka juya.
body: An sami wani mutum can ƙarshen lungun, kusa da tsohon bangon bulo.
hand: Hannunsa na dama ya damƙe wani abu sosai.
button: Nia ta buɗe yatsunsa a hankali. A ciki akwai maɓallin tagulla guda ɗaya.
not-his: Ta duba rigarsa. Duk maɓallan suna nan. Wannan ta wani ne daban.
witness: Babu makami. Babu walat. Mashaidiya ɗaya tak: wata yarinya da ta rantse ba ta ga komai ba.
witness.ask: Me ya sa yarinyar ta ce ba ta ga komai ba?
step: Ta zauna a kan matattakalar gidan burodi a ƙarƙashin wata babbar laima, tana riƙe da kofin shayin da ba ta taɓa ba.
ama: Sunanta Ama. Ta yi kama da ’yar shekara goma sha tara.
crouch: Nia ta tsugunna kusa da ita. “Kin ga wani abu a daren yau?”
asleep: “Ba komai,” in ji Ama, ba tare da ta ɗago kai ba. “Ina barci.”
window: Duk da haka, har yanzu fitilar tagar da ke saman gidan burodi, daidai bisa ƙaramar hanyar, tana kunne.
wait: Nia ba ta kira ta maƙaryaciya ba. Ta ce kawai, “Zan kasance kusa.”
streetlight: Amma fitilar titi da ke saman lungun ta yini tana ƙyallawa duk daren.
streetlight.ask: Me ya sa fitilar titin take ƙyallawa?
broken: “Wancan fitilar ta lalace shekaru da yawa da suka wuce,” in ji Bello. “Ba wanda ya taɓa gyara ta.”
not-random: Nia ta lura cewa ƙyallawar tana bin wani tsari ne.
pattern: Takan ɗauke na daƙiƙa uku, sannan ta ƙyalla sau biyu.
again: Daƙiƙa uku na duhu. Walƙiya biyu. Sannan duhu ya sake komawa.
message: Haka ta riƙa yi, kamar wani yana aika saƙo.
someone: Fitila ba ta kirga. Wani da ke kusa ne yake sa ta yin haka.
someone.ask: Wa ke sa fitilar ta dinga ƙyalli?
key: Ta bi tsarin ƙyallawar har zuwa sandar fitilar, ta sami wani ƙaramin mabuɗin tagulla da aka maƙala da tef a ƙasanta.
wall: Nia ta juya a hankali. A ƙarshen lungun, kusa da mutumin, tsohuwar katangar bulo tana tsaye.
patch: Yawancin tubalin sun yi duhu kuma sun tsufa. Amma wani ɓangare ya fi haske kuma ya fi sabo, kuma yana da siffar ƙofa.
patch.ask: Me ya sa wasu tubalan suka fi sabo?
door: Mabuɗin ya dace da wata ƙofa da aka rufe da bulaye shekara ashirin da suka wuce.
door.ask: Wa ya rufe ƙofar da bulaye?
pull: Suka cire tubalan da suka saki ɗaya bayan ɗaya, cikin ruwan sama.
groan: Mabuɗin ya juya da ƙaran tsatsa, sai wata ƙaramar ƙofar katako ta buɗe.
cupboard: A bayan bulayen akwai kabad, a cikinsa kuwa hoto ɗaya tak.
photo: Hoton ya nuna mashaidiyar tana ƙarama ƙwarai, tsaye kusa da mutumin da ya ɓace.
writing: A bayansa, da tawada da ta dusashe: “Titin Marlow. Daren da fitilu suka ɗauke.”
writing.ask: Me ya faru a daren da wutar lantarki ta ɗauke?
blackout: Shekaru ashirin da suka wuce, duk titin ya rasa wutar lantarki har zuwa safe.
vanished: Kuma a wannan dare, wani mutum daga Titin Marlow ya ɓace. Ba a taɓa samunsa ba.
same-face: Nia ta dubi hoton, sannan ta dubi mutumin da ke gefen bango. Fuskar dai ɗaya ce, amma ta girmi ta hoton da shekara ashirin.
came-back: Bai mutu a daren nan ba. Ya gudu ne. Kuma a daren yau, ya dawo.
buttons: A cikin hoton, wani mutum na biyu yana tsaye rabinsa a wajen firam ɗin. Rigarsa tana da jeri na maɓallan tagulla.
wire: Sai Nia ta ɗaga kai ta duba. Wata siririyar waya ta miƙe daga turken fitila, ta bi jikin bango, har zuwa tagar Ama mai haske.
switch: Wani a can sama ya yi ta magana da ita tsawon dare, cikin haske.
daughter: A cikin hoton, ƙaramar yarinyar ta riƙe hannunsa kamar yadda diya take yi.
truth: Ba wai yarinyar ba ta ga komai ba ne. Ta ga komai, tana kuma jiran wanda zai yi mata tambayar da ta dace.
truth.ask: Me ya sa yarinyar take jira?
rain-softer: Ruwan saman ya lafa. Fitilar ta daina ƙiftawa, ta ci gaba da haskawa kawai.
walk-back: Nia ta koma ta cikin kududdufai zuwa matattakalar gidan burodi.
looked-up: Ama ta ajiye shayinta mai sanyi, kuma a karon farko a daren nan, ta ɗago kai ta kalle ta.
right-question: Kuma Nia ta san ainihin abin da za ta tambaya.
